name: Finanzas BBVA
format: Maintainer action recipe; NOT an installable Apple shortcut

pair: Accept text JSON from shortcuts://run-shortcut. Require mode=pair and version=1.
Require input.origin to equal pinnedOrigin EXACTLY. Never trust a URL received from a website/notification as a destination.
POST pinnedOrigin + /api/integrations/shortcuts/pairing/exchange with JSON {code: input.code}. Do not put the code in the HTTP URL.
If response contains an error or lacks token/deviceId/pairingId, stop and show the error. A spent code cannot be retried to retrieve a token.
Save {origin: pinnedOrigin, token, deviceId, expiresAt} in the user's private configuration file, separate from the shortcut actions. No clipboard, shared link, analytics or logs.
POST pinnedOrigin + /api/integrations/shortcuts/check with Authorization: Bearer <saved token>.
Require response.ok=true before reporting connection verified. No event is submitted for this check.
Open pinnedOrigin + /notifications?pairing=<response pairingId>. Never include token/code in the callback URL.
manualCheckWithoutNotification: Read saved configuration. Require saved origin to equal pinnedOrigin.
POST /api/integrations/shortcuts/check with saved bearer. Report only success/error; never show the token.
notification: Read saved configuration; require pinned origin and nonempty token. Otherwise stop and ask to reconnect from the PWA.
Get the ORIGINAL notification message from Shortcut Input using the property actually verified on a real iPhone. Do not assume an undocumented property name.
If there is no usable message, stop. Do not manufacture an amount, account, date or merchant.
Generate UUID once. Keep it in a variable for this event and every retry of that same request.
POST /api/integrations/shortcuts/events with bearer and JSON {eventId: UUID, body: original message, sourceApp: BBVA}.
Only include title/subtitle/occurredAt/merchant/bankReference if the bank supplies them unequivocally. Never use receipt time as occurredAt.
Accept 202 or duplicate 200. On 401 reconnect; on 409 stop; on 429/503 retain the original UUID if a retry is offered. Never retry with a new UUID.
